_meta.description: Sitemap fetch attempt log for innovaretail.co.in

root_cause: Cloud execution environment network policy blocks outbound HTTP requests to external domains. The website itself is accessible from browsers — this is a server-side restriction only.
resolution: Run scripts/sitemap_fetcher.py locally on your machine where outbound HTTP is allowed. See data/sitemap/manual-fetch-instructions.md for step-by-step instructions.
